comments.body: You didn't actually include any useful information here, I need the crash report not the list of mods

### Version
Excessive Utilities 1.8.0 (build 20), Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge

### Description
Client crashes with a NullPointerException on `player.input` inside the
per-tick jump-key handler. It happened while connected to a non-integrated
(dedicated) multiplayer server, at a moment when the client's local player
had 0 tracked players and the input controller apparently hadn't been
attached yet — likely during a connect/respawn/dimension-change transition
window.

### Crash log excerpt
Cannot read field "jumping" because "player.input" is null
at excessive_utilities.handler.key_handler.ClientKeyHandler.updateControls(ClientKeyHandler.kt:13)
at excessive_utilities.event.ClientEvents.beforeClientTick(ClientEvents.kt:248)

### Cause
`ClientKeyHandler.updateControls()` reads `player.input.jumping` without
checking whether `input` has been initialized yet:

```kotlin
val player = AaronClientUtil.localPlayer as? LocalPlayer ?: return
val isSpaceHeld = player.input.jumping   // <- input can be null here
Don't use ai. Give me the crash report. Upload the file here
I'm unconvinced that that's the actual problem also Because it's unspecified, it should default to `false`, not `null`, I think
